description: This file is a shell script used for testing corner cases of 'git-archive'. It contains setup, execution, and verification steps for various scenarios involving git archive formats, compression, large files, and edge cases related to tar and zip archives.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory and ensures cleanup after the test.

methods.name: check_dir
methods.description: Checks if the directory contains the expected set of files.

methods.name: build_tree
methods.description: Builds a large tree of blobs with long paths for testing.
